en: Narin (나린) — Wind-Chasing Hunter (바람 사냥꾼, archer captain)
character: Narin: lean, tanned woman in her twenties, very long wild dark-brown hair blowing back, green headband with two long trailing tails, calm narrow eyes, small gold hoop earring, dark forest-green hooded cloak/mantle with lime-green trim and a lime leaf-shaped brooch, gold toggle clasps, brown leather cross-strap with square buckle, brown wooden longbow with gold bands, quiver of white-fletched arrows on her back.
colours: skin #c68a5c, hair #2b1d14 (long), outfit #2a4a3a (dark forest green), accent #a7d26a (lime trim, headband); secondary: brown leather #5a3a22-ish, gold fittings #d9a441-ish
notes: Weapon: a plain brown wooden longbow with gold grip bands (as in the portrait), held in the far-forward hand so the whole limb and string sit on magenta outside the body; one bow only.
Quiver with a few white-fletched arrows stays on her back; an arrow appears only nocked in the wind-up pose, never in flight in the strike pose (the engine draws projectiles).
Hair is long and windswept like the portrait but kept as a compact mass streaming BEHIND her (to the left) so it never covers the bow, bow arm or face; headband tails stream back with it.
Green headband, gold hoop earring and lime leaf brooch stay visible in every pose; cloak is dark green with clear lime trim so it does not merge into dark terrain.
No wind lines, leaves, glow or motion effects even though she is the 'wind' hunter.
poses: 1 idle: bow held low in front in the forward hand, string side facing her, ready, wide stance with bent knees.
2 wind-up: full draw: arrow nocked, string pulled back to the cheek, bow arm straight out in front of the body on magenta.
3 strike: release: bow arm extended, string straight, drawing hand flung far back behind the shoulder, NO arrow in flight.
4 hit: torso thrown back, weight on the rear leg, head jerked back, bow dropped low-forward clear of the body.
ko_notes: 나린: 갈색 피부, 바람에 날리는 긴 흑갈색 머리, 꼬리 달린 녹색 머리띠, 금 귀걸이, 진녹색 망토+연두 장식, 나뭇잎 브로치, 금테 나무 장궁, 등에 화살통. 가이드 무기 bow. 화살은 준비 자세에서만, 날아가는 화살·바람 효과 없음. 머리카락은 뒤로 날려 활을 가리지 않게.

en: Moro (모로) — Rat King of the Port (그림자 두목, rogue captain)
character: Moro: wiry man in his forties, cunning toothy rat-like grin, wavy shoulder-length brown hair spilling out of a deep dark-plum hood, short beard and stubble, small cheek scar, gold hoop earrings, dark plum hooded cloak with gold trim and a gold round brooch, gold chain across the chest, brown leather belt with square buckle, gold rings on his fingers, a single straight steel dagger with a gold crossguard.
colours: skin #e0ac7e, hair #5a3720, outfit #1a1420 (near-black plum), accent #d9a441 (gold trim, rings, chain); dagger blade neutral steel ~#d8dde3
notes: Weapon: ONE straight dagger with a gold crossguard in the near hand, where the guide mannequin holds its dagger (the guide's short reverse-grip dagger is the placeholder). The blade must be neutral light steel (~#d8dde3) with a 1px dark outline and about 1.5x a normal dagger length (Lyra lesson).
The dagger sits OUTSIDE the cloak silhouette on magenta in every pose; never in front of the dark cloak where it vanishes at 64px.
His skill throws poisoned daggers, but draw NO thrown knives, no knives in flight and no second weapon in hand; no poison drips, smoke or glow.
Hood stays up in every pose with the face and grin readable; keep gold trim, gold brooch, chain and rings as bold gold blocks so the near-black outfit has readable edges.
Plum shadows/highlights stay dark and desaturated (no pink or bright violet) to keep the magenta distance >= 170.
poses: 1 idle: crouched ready stance, dagger held forward-low in the near hand out beside the body, free hand raised as a guard, sly grin.
2 wind-up: dagger arm drawn back high behind and above the head, blade clear of hood and cloak on magenta, body coiled.
3 strike: lunge forward, dagger thrust/slash across at full arm extension in front of the body.
4 hit: torso thrown back, weight on the rear leg, head jerked back in the hood, dagger hand flung out to the side away from the cloak.
ko_notes: 모로: 40대, 쥐 같은 능글맞은 웃음, 후드 밖으로 나온 곱슬 갈색 머리, 수염, 금 귀걸이·반지·사슬, 금테 검자주 망토. 가이드 무기 none + 금 코등이 단검 한 자루. 리라 교훈대로 날은 밝은 강철색·1.5배 길이·항상 망토 바깥. 투척 단검·독 효과 그리지 않음.

en: Cassian (카시안) — Excommunicated Spellblade (마검사, mage captain)
character: Cassian: tall, elegant man in his thirties, long wavy ash-silver hair to mid-back, stern blue eyes, two thin diagonal scars on the cheek, high-collared dark navy long coat with pale-cyan trim and swirl embroidery on the shoulder cape, small gold four-point star brooch; wields a one-handed rune longsword (straight light-steel blade engraved with flat pale-cyan runes, gold cross-guard, dark wrapped grip).
colours: skin #f5d6b8, hair #c9c2b8 (long), outfit #2a2a6a (dark navy), accent #7fd6e8 (pale cyan trim, blade runes); gold fittings ~#d9a441, blade steel ~#c8ccd2
notes: Weapon (owner decision): ONE ONE-HANDED longsword in the near hand (flat pale-cyan runes along the blade, gold cross-guard, short dark grip) — NOT the portrait's crystal staff (take only face, hair and coat from portrait.png). The guide's SHIELD is only a placeholder: NO shield — the off hand is empty and open (a spell-caster's hand) where the guide shows the shield, with no glow or effect around it.
Runes are FLAT cyan #7fd6e8 lines on a light neutral-steel blade (~#c8ccd2) with a dark outline: NO glow, no blue smoke, no floating runes or particles (the engine draws the '마력검' slash).
Blade stays outside the head/hair and coat silhouette on magenta in every pose; long hair is kept as a compact mass behind the shoulders.
Coat is dark navy-blue, not violet; keep any purple highlights blue-shifted and dark (magenta rule), cyan trim crisp so the coat reads on dark terrain.
Cheek scars and the gold star brooch remain visible.
poses: 1 idle: guard stance, sword held one-handed in the near hand, blade angled up and forward across the front of the body on magenta; free hand open at chest height in front, palm out (where the guide shield is).
2 wind-up: sword drawn back high over the near shoulder, blade behind and above the head on magenta; free hand thrust forward open, weight on the back leg.
3 strike: deep lunge, sword arm fully extended in a forward cut, blade angled down and forward in front of the body; free hand pulled in to the chest — NO trail, NO glow, NO effect.
4 hit: torso thrown back, weight on the rear leg, head jerked back, sword hanging low in the near hand pointing down-forward away from the body; free hand flung up and back, open.
ko_notes: 카시안: 긴 물결 은발, 뺨의 두 줄 흉터, 남색 하이칼라 코트+하늘색 장식, 금 별 브로치. 무기는 주인 결정(2026-11-25)으로 청록 룬이 새겨진 한손 장검(가이드 sword_shield — 방패는 자리 표시일 뿐 없음, 빈 왼손은 마법사처럼 펼친 손, 효과 없음) — 초상화의 수정 지팡이는 쓰지 않는다(얼굴·머리·코트만 초상화에서). 룬은 평평한 하늘색 선, 빛·연기·궤적 없음(마력검 베기는 엔진 효과). 칼날은 몸 바깥, 보라 대신 짙은 남색.

en: Eleanor (엘리노어) — Knight of Holy Light (성광 기사, cleric captain)
character: Eleanor: noble young woman knight in her twenties, long wavy golden hair with a braided crown and a large white ribbon bow at the back, calm blue eyes, bare-headed (no helmet, as in the portrait), white plate armour with gold trim and gold four-point star emblems on the breastplate and pauldrons, white gauntlets, wielding a gold spiked star-headed mace (morning-star head on a steel haft).
colours: skin #f2c9a0, hair #e3c565 (long), outfit #e8e4d8 (ivory-white plate), accent #f2c94c (gold trim, stars, mace head); armour shadows cool grey ~#9a96a0
notes: Weapon: a one-handed mace with a gold spiked star-shaped head on a steel haft (not a staff — the staff guide is only the healer pose base); no shield.
Bare-headed with the white ribbon and braid as in the portrait (the data's 'helmet' headgear is overridden by the portrait).
Mace head stays outside the head/hair silhouette on magenta in every pose; outline the gold mace head darkly so it does not merge with her golden hair.
No holy light, halo, glow or sparkles (the engine draws heal/smite effects).
White armour needs grey-blue shading and a dark outline so it reads on snow and pale terrain; gold star emblems stay large and simple.
poses: 1 idle: mace held ready in the near hand, head raised beside and ahead of the shoulder, free hand low, wide stance.
2 wind-up: mace raised high in the near hand, star head above and behind the head, free hand lifted, weight back.
3 strike: lunge; free hand thrust forward with an open palm (heal / smite gesture); mace held upright behind in the near hand, star head clear of hair and body — NO glow, NO effect.
4 hit: torso thrown back, weight on the rear leg, head jerked back, mace dropped low and out to the side.
ko_notes: 엘리노어: 긴 금발 물결머리+땋은 왕관, 흰 리본, 투구 없음(초상화 우선), 금 테두리 흰 판금, 가슴·어깨 금 별 문양, 금빛 별 모양 가시 철퇴(방패 없음). 세라핀처럼 가이드 staff. 빛·후광 없음, 흰 갑옷은 회청색 음영+진한 외곽선, 철퇴 머리는 금발과 안 겹치게.

en: Garmak (가르마크) — Warlord of a Hundred Battles (전쟁군주, warrior captain)
character: Garmak: huge, broad-shouldered man in his forties, long dark-red hair and a big braided red beard, heavy brows, scar across the nose and cheek, grey iron horned helmet with curved ivory horns and a star emblem, grey wolf-fur mantle, crimson cloak, iron lion-head round clasp, brown leather harness with square buckle, a huge two-handed war axe (broad crescent steel head, long dark haft with a red-wrapped grip and an iron butt cap).
colours: skin #c68a5c, hair #8c2f2f (red, beard braided), outfit #5a3a1a (brown leather), accent #d6455d (crimson cloak); fur grey-brown ~#8a7a6a, iron ~#8a8a8a
notes: Weapon (owner decision): ONE heavy two-handed WAR AXE (broad crescent steel head, long dark haft with a red-wrapped grip) — matching his skill '전쟁 도끼'. Do NOT draw the greatsword from his back in the portrait. The guide katana is a placeholder: the axe head sits where the blade tip is.
Axe head stays outside the body silhouette on magenta in every pose; give it a neutral grey steel with a dark outline so it reads against the grey fur and red cloak.

Bulky and broad (wide chest, thick arms) but still exactly 4 heads tall and the same scale as other captains — not a giant; horned helmet stays on in every pose and the horns are not counted in the height.
Fur mantle and crimson cloak kept as large simple shapes; cloak must not cover the axe or the axe arms.
No rally-horn, banner or effects (his rally skill is drawn by the engine).
poses: 1 idle: two-handed war axe held diagonally in front, axe head forward-up, wide low stance.
2 wind-up: axe raised high over the rear shoulder in both hands, weight back, axe head clear above and behind the helmet horns.
3 strike: step-in lunge, axe cleaving down and forward at full extension, axe head out in front of the front foot.
4 hit: torso thrown back, weight on the rear leg, head jerked back, axe dropped low.
ko_notes: 가르마크: 거구(그래도 4등신·같은 배율), 붉은 장발과 땋은 붉은 수염, 코·뺨 흉터, 뿔 달린 철투구, 회색 늑대 모피, 진홍 망토, 사자 걸쇠. 무기는 주인 결정(2026-11-25)으로 스킬명대로 양손 전쟁 도끼(가이드 katana 자리) — 초상화 등의 대검은 그리지 않는다. 도끼날은 몸 바깥, 회색 강철+진한 외곽선.

en: Temur (테무르) — Khan of the Steppe (초원의 칸, archer captain)
character: Temur: strong nomad man in his thirties, dark brown skin, long dark-brown hair in loose locks plus two thick braids bound with gold rings, short goatee, gold hoop earring, heavy cream-white fur collar, brown steppe coat (deel) with gold curling embroidery and a round gold medallion clasp, recurved composite bow with gold bands, quiver of white-fletched arrows on his back.
colours: skin #8d5a3b, hair #2b1d14 (long, braids), outfit #8a5a2a (brown coat), accent #e8c86a (gold embroidery, rings); fur cream ~#e8dcc8
notes: Weapon: a recurved composite bow with strongly curled tips and gold bands (as in the portrait), held out in front so it sits on magenta outside the body; one bow only.
On foot — NO horse (his '기마 돌격' charge is drawn by the engine; do not make a mounted version).
Arrow only nocked in the wind-up; no arrow in flight in the strike pose; quiver stays on the back.
Gold-ringed braids, fur collar and gold medallion stay visible; give the cream fur a darker outline and shading so it does not read as a blank blob on snow/desert.
Brown coat needs dark outline and darker leather accents so he does not vanish on desert sand.
poses: 1 idle: recurved bow held low in front, ready, wide stance with bent knees.
2 wind-up: full draw: arrow nocked, string pulled back toward the cheek, bow arm straight out in front.
3 strike: release: bow arm extended, string straight, drawing hand flung far back behind the shoulder, NO arrow in flight.
4 hit: torso thrown back, weight on the rear leg, head jerked back, bow dropped low-forward clear of the body.
ko_notes: 테무르: 짙은 갈색 피부, 금고리로 묶은 두 가닥 땋은 머리+긴 흑갈색 머리, 염소수염, 금 귀걸이, 크림색 모피 깃, 금 자수 갈색 유목 코트, 금 원형 걸쇠, 끝이 말린 복합궁. 가이드 bow. 말 없음(도보), 날아가는 화살 없음. 모피·코트는 사막·눈밭에서 안 묻히게 진한 외곽선.

en: Sieglinde (지크린데) — Dragonslayer (용살자, warrior captain)
character: Sieglinde: battle-hardened, athletic woman in her thirties, wild long golden-blonde hair with a side braid, stern dark eyes, scar across the brow and a slash scar on the cheek, bare-headed (no helmet, as in the portrait), dark crimson dragon-scale armour with orange-gold trim and layered scale pauldrons, brown leather belt with gold buckle, huge two-handed greatsword with a gold crossguard and red-wrapped grip.
colours: skin #f2c9a0, hair #e3c565 (long), outfit #6a1a14 (dark crimson scale), accent #f39c12 (orange-gold trim, hilt); blade neutral steel ~#c8ccd2
notes: Weapon: a very large two-handed European greatsword (gold crossguard, red-wrapped grip), not a katana; the blade stays outside the body silhouette on magenta in every pose.
Bare-headed as in the portrait (the data's 'helmet' headgear is overridden); her face scars stay visible.
Dragon-scale armour as a few large scale rows and plates, not noisy texture; crimson darks shift toward brown, not toward magenta/pink.
No fire, dragon motifs as effects, glow or slash trails; her execution dash is drawn by the engine.
Hair is a big mass but kept behind the head so it never covers the sword or face.
poses: 1 idle: two-handed greatsword held diagonally in front, point forward-up, wide low stance.
2 wind-up: sword raised high over the rear shoulder, weight back, blade clear of the hair mass.
3 strike: step-in lunge, sword cut down and forward at full extension.
4 hit: torso thrown back, weight on the rear leg, head jerked back, sword dropped low.
ko_notes: 지크린데: 30대, 사납게 퍼진 긴 금발+옆 땋은 머리, 이마·뺨 흉터, 투구 없음(초상화 우선), 진홍 용비늘 갑옷+주황 금테, 금 코등이 양손 대검. 가이드 katana(그롬과 같은 대검 자세). 칼날 몸 바깥, 불·용 효과 없음, 비늘은 큰 덩어리로.

en: Mordecai (모르데카이) — Demon Hunter (마귀 사냥꾼, cleric captain)
character: Mordecai: grizzled, sturdy man in his fifties, deep dark-charcoal hood and long hooded cloak with ash-grey trim and cross motifs, grey hair strands and a short grey beard, deeply lined scowling face, bandolier of large silver bullets/cartridges across the chest, small bone-white cross pendant, holding a holy mace: dark wrapped haft with a gold band and a spiked round head bearing a cross.
colours: skin #e0ac7e, hair #c9c2b8 (grey), outfit #2a2a3a (charcoal), accent #c9c2b8 (ash-grey trim, crosses); silver bullets ~#d8dde3, gold band ~#d9a441
notes: Weapon: ONE holy mace with a spiked round head marked with a cross (as in the portrait); the staff guide is just the cleric pose base. No gun, no crossbow, no shield.
Silver bullets are worn as a chest bandolier only; his '은탄' shot is drawn by the engine — no bullets in flight, no muzzle flash.
Mace head stays outside the hood/cloak silhouette on magenta in every pose; outline it darkly and keep it lighter than the cloak so it reads at 64px.
Hood up in every pose with the bearded face visible; ash-grey trim drawn as bold lines so the charcoal cloak has edges on dark terrain.
No holy light, exorcism glow, runes or smoke.
poses: 1 idle: mace held ready in the near hand, head out ahead of the shoulder, free hand low near the bandolier, wide stance.
2 wind-up: mace raised high in the near hand, head above and behind the hood, free hand lifted, weight back.
3 strike: lunge; free hand thrust forward open-palmed (the ward); mace held upright behind in the near hand, head clear of the hood and cloak — NO glow, NO effect.
4 hit: torso thrown back, weight on the rear leg, head jerked back in the hood, mace dropped low and out to the side.
ko_notes: 모르데카이: 50대, 깊은 숯색 후드 망토+잿빛 테두리·십자 문양, 회색 머리·짧은 회색 수염, 주름진 얼굴, 가슴에 은탄 탄띠, 십자 박힌 가시 철퇴. 가이드 staff(세라핀식). 총·석궁 없음, 날아가는 은탄·빛 효과 없음. 철퇴 머리는 망토 바깥, 후드 계속 씀.

en: Rico (리코) — The Singing Blade (음유 검객, rogue)
character: Rico: flamboyant young man in his twenties, slim agile build, long wavy dark-red hair in a loose braid over the shoulder, confident smirk, two thin diagonal scars on the left cheek, gold hoop earring; wide-brimmed plum tricorn-style hat with gold trim, gold round badge and a big cream feather; plum frock coat with gold buttons, gold-edged collar and short shoulder cape, cream ruffled jabot; a rapier with a gold cup/swept hilt in hand and a small round-bodied lute strapped on his back.
colours: skin #f2c9a0, hair #8c2f2f (long), outfit #7a2a5a (plum), accent #f2c94c (gold trim/buttons); portrait extras: feather and jabot cream ~#e0d2c0, lute warm brown/ochre
notes: Real weapon is ONE rapier (thin straight blade, gold swept/cup hilt) in the near hand; the guide's shield is a placeholder — NO shield: the free hand is empty and open, palm out, exactly where the guide holds the shield.

Rapier blade: neutral light steel (~#d8dde3) with a 1px dark outline, about the guide sword's length (long and thin, not longer: it must keep 32 px from the neighbouring poses), always held out on the magenta background, never laid across the plum coat (a thin blade over the dark coat vanishes at 64px).
Lute stays strapped flat on his back as a small prop (top of the neck may peek above the shoulder); never played, never swung, no notes or music symbols.
Feathered hat stays on in every pose; feather is a big simple cream shape; long red hair visible below the brim.
Plum outfit: keep the lightest plum no brighter/pinker than ~#8e4a62 (shift highlights toward warm grey-rose, not pink) so every colour stays >=170 from #FF00FF.
No sparkles, music notes, slash trails or glow (the engine draws the 'battle song' buff).
poses: idle: fencer's stance side-on, knees bent, rapier extended forward-low in the near hand, free hand open at chest height in front (where the guide holds the shield); blade fully on the background in front of the body.
wind-up: rapier drawn back high beside the head with the point aimed forward, weight on the rear leg, free hand reaching forward for balance; blade above/behind the hat brim, not across the coat.

strike: deep fencing lunge, front knee bent, rapier arm at full extension straight forward, free hand open at the chest where the guide holds the shield; the blade reaches past the front foot on the background.
hit: torso thrown back, weight on the rear leg, head jerked back (hat stays on), rapier arm flung out and down away from the body, free hand up.
ko_notes: 리코: 붉은 장발·깃털 모자·자주 코트의 음유 검객. 실제 무기는 레이피어 한 자루(가이드는 검+방패, 방패 없음, 빈손은 가이드 방패 자리에 편 손). 날은 밝은 강철색으로 늘 몸 바깥. 류트는 등에 메기만(연주·음표 없음). 자주색 밝은 면은 분홍으로 가지 않게.

en: Orga (오르가) — Mother of the Wolf Pack (야수 조련사, archer)
character: Orga: dark-skinned woman in her thirties, strong athletic build, long thick dark-brown wavy hair with a braid, stern face, white war-paint stripes on the forehead and across the cheek, gold earrings; huge grey-and-cream wolf-fur mantle over the shoulders fastened with a round gold wolf-head medallion, dark brown leather tunic with brown strap and square gold buckle, headband; a dark wooden longbow with gold-capped tips and a quiver of cream-fletched arrows on her back.
colours: skin #8d5a3b, hair #2b1d14 (long), outfit #5a4a3a (brown leather), accent #d9a441 (gold medallion/tips); portrait extras: wolf fur grey ~#8a8690 with cream ~#e0d4c4 tips, face paint ~#ece6dc
notes: Main weapon is ONE longbow (dark wood, gold-capped tips); bow and string stay outside the body silhouette on the magenta background in every pose.

The grey wolf from the portrait is NOT drawn (no companion animal, no wolf head on the ground) — the wolf-pack skill is drawn by the engine; the wolf theme lives in the fur mantle and gold wolf medallion.
Wolf-fur mantle as a few big jagged grey/cream fur clumps over both shoulders, not pixel noise; keep it from swallowing the bow arm.
White face-paint stripes on forehead and cheek must read at 64px (one or two bold pixels-wide strokes).
Arrow only in the wind-up (nocked); NO arrow in flight, no motion lines, no glow.
poses: idle: wide hunter's stance, knees bent, bow held low in front in the near hand with the bow away from the body, drawing hand resting near the quiver strap.
wind-up: full draw — arrow nocked, string pulled back to the cheek, bow arm extended straight forward, bow upright clear of the fur mantle.
strike: release — bow arm still extended, string straight, drawing hand flung far back behind the shoulder (clearly further than in the wind-up), NO arrow in flight.
hit: torso thrown back, weight on the rear leg, head and hair jerked back, bow dropped low-forward away from the body.
ko_notes: 오르가: 짙은 피부·흑갈색 장발·흰 전투 칠·회색 늑대 모피 망토의 조련사. 무기는 장궁 하나. 초상화의 늑대는 그리지 않음(늑대는 엔진이 연출, 모피·금 늑대 메달로 표현). 화살은 준비 자세에만, 쏜 뒤 손을 크게 뒤로.

en: Brok (브로크) — The Rune-Carving Smith (룬 대장장이, warrior)

no floating stars, orbs or magic circles; the casting hand is open and empty (the engine draws the arcane beam and falling star)
no hat (as the portrait): gold circlet only; very long hair falls down her back but stays inside the figure's space
white hair shaded lavender/blue-grey (never pink or magenta) and outlined so it does not merge with the pale trim
stars on the robe: a few large gold shapes, not noise; staff head always above or in front of the figure, clear of the hair
poses: idle: calm upright stance, staff planted at her side in the near hand with the crescent head above her shoulder, free hand low
wind-up: staff raised high in the near hand, free hand lifted and drawn back, weight on the back leg, gathering
strike: lunge; free arm thrust straight forward, palm open toward the enemy (casting); staff held upright behind, head clear of the body
hit: torso thrown back, weight on the rear leg, head jerked back wincing, hair swinging, staff dropped low
ko_notes: 에우리아: 주름진 노년 여인, 아주 긴 흰(연보라 음영) 웨이브 머리, 별 장식 금 서클릿, 별 귀걸이, 금별 수놓은 짙은 남색 로브, 연보라 안감, 금 팔각별 브로치. 무기는 금 초승달 지팡이(어두운 원반 + 작은 별, 빛 없음). 모자 없음(초상화대로). 떠다니는 별·마법진 금지, 시전 손은 빈 손바닥.

en: Lucia
character: Lucia, prophesied apostle of light, young woman around twenty, slender build, very long wavy golden hair, blue eyes, gentle smile, gold leaf circlet with a white flower and a short white veil, layered cream-white robes and cape with orange flame embroidery on the hem, gold eight-pointed star brooch, gold belt, white gloves, sun-headed mace scepter.
colours: skin #f2c9a0, hair #e3c565 (long), robes #f2ecd8 (warm cream, shaded beige), accent #f39c12 (orange-gold embroidery, star, mace head)
notes: weapon: a long sun-mace scepter (white haft with gold bands, spiked sun head) — the guide staff is the haft, about 3/4 of its length, the sun head where the guide orb is
NO light: no glow around the hands, no halo, no rays or sparkles on the mace or brooch — the engine draws her heals; the sun head is a flat gold-orange spiked disc with a pale cream centre
cream robes are never pure white: mid warm beige shadows and a dark outline so she reads on snow; orange flame embroidery as a few large shapes
flower, circlet and veil stay small and on the head; long hair stays inside the figure's space
slots 2-3 are her cast poses (the same sheet is used for her heals); the forward hand is open and empty
poses: idle: serene stance, sun-mace held upright at her side in the near hand with the head above the shoulder, free hand low
wind-up: sun-mace raised high in the near hand, free hand lifted and drawn back, weight on the back leg, gathering
strike: lunge; free arm extended straight forward, palm open (blessing); sun-mace held upright behind, head clear of hair and body
hit: torso thrown back, weight on the rear leg, head jerked back wincing, hair and veil swinging, mace dropped low
ko_notes: 루치아: 긴 금발 웨이브, 파란 눈, 흰 꽃·금 잎 서클릿과 짧은 흰 베일, 주황 불꽃 자수의 크림색 로브·망토, 금 팔각별 브로치, 흰 장갑. 무기는 태양 머리 철퇴 홀(흰 자루·금 띠, 가이드 지팡이 3/4 길이). 손·머리의 빛, 후광, 반짝임 모두 금지(엔진 효과). 로브는 순백이 아닌 따뜻한 크림+베이지 그늘. 2·3번 치유 시전 자세.

en: Nikla
character: Nikla, queen of the shadow guilds, elegant dangerous woman in her thirties, lithe build, long wavy blue-black hair, tan skin, dark-red eyes, faint scar on the cheek, knowing smile, deep plum-black hood and cloak with crimson trim and a gold emblem clasp, ruby earring and pendant, dark corset with gold-buckled leather belts, dark boots, long dagger with a red-wrapped grip and gold guard.
colours: skin #e0ac7e, hair #1b1420 (long, blue-black), outfit #1a0a2a (deep plum, painted dark charcoal-violet), accent #d6455d (crimson trim), gold fittings
notes: ONE long dagger (red-wrapped grip, gold guard) in the near hand; the second dagger stays sheathed on her back with only its hilt over the far shoulder — never two blades in hand
the blade is bright neutral steel (~#d8dde3, no blue or violet tint), about 1.5x a normal dagger, 1 px dark outline, and always on the magenta background outside the body (Lyra lesson)
dark outfit vanishes on dark ground: paint it dark charcoal-violet (not black), cool rim light on the upper-left edges, slightly lighter outline
crimson trim stays red (highlights toward orange-red, never pink); plum lit side stays dark violet (magenta rule)
hood up in every pose with the face visible; no shadow smoke, afterimages or trails (the engine draws the shadow flurry)
poses: idle: low crouched stance, dagger hand held out to the side away from the cloak with the blade on the background, free hand up as a guard
wind-up: body coiled, dagger arm drawn back high behind and above the head, blade at least 32 px clear of the hood
strike: dashing lunge; dagger arm fully extended forward slashing across, free hand flung back, cloak trailing
hit: torso thrown back, weight on the rear leg, head jerked back wincing, hood still up, dagger hand flung out
ko_notes: 니클라: 진홍 테 짙은 자주빛 후드·망토, 금 문장 걸쇠, 긴 청흑색 웨이브 머리, 루비 귀걸이·펜던트, 금 버클 가죽 띠. 손에는 붉은 손잡이 긴 단검 하나, 두 번째 단검은 등에 꽂혀 손잡이만 보이게. 날은 중성 밝은 강철색·1.5배 길이·몸 바깥 배경 위(리라 교훈). 검정 대신 숯빛 보라 + 림 라이트, 빨강은 분홍 쪽으로 가지 않게. 그림자 효과 없음.

en: Urg
character: Urg, last of the giant-blooded tribe, man in his thirties, enormous muscular build with huge shoulders and bare arms, long wild brown hair, short brown beard, blue eyes, pale war-paint scar streaks on the cheek, gold earring, white fur collar, dark-brown leather harness and tunic with gold fittings and a large gold rune medallion on the shoulder, fur-wrapped boots, huge two-handed stone maul with a gold spiral rune and gold-banded haft.
colours: skin #c68a5c, hair/beard #5a3720 (long), leather #5a3a2a, accent #e8c86a (gold fittings, rune, medallion), fur off-white, maul head grey stone
notes: the guide katana is a placeholder: draw a HUGE two-handed maul (grey stone/iron block head about 1 head wide with one gold spiral rune, dark wooden haft with gold bands), head where the blade tip is

size_class large: still 4 heads tall with the 110 px head, the size comes from a much broader, heavier body (shoulders and arms about 1.5x a normal captain); the sheet may need a larger cell (like the lancer's 112)
the maul head always sits on the background outside the body (above, behind or in front), never in front of the torso
NO ground crack, dust, shockwave or debris on the strike — the engine draws the earth slam
skin as in the portrait (warm tan, not stone-grey); fur collar and gold medallion stay visible; no tribal sigils beyond the one rune
poses: idle: massive wide stance, maul held diagonally across the front in both hands, head up to the right clear of the body
wind-up: weight on the back leg; maul heaved high over the rear shoulder in both hands, head above and behind the head
strike: step-in lunge; maul slammed down and forward at full extension, head out in front of the front foot at about knee height (never below the soles line y=870)
hit: torso thrown back, weight on the rear leg, head jerked back wincing, hair swinging, maul dropped low in the near hand, free arm flung up
ko_notes: 우르그: 거구(어깨·팔이 보통 대장의 약 1.5배, 그래도 4등신·머리 110px), 긴 갈색 머리·수염, 뺨의 흰 전투 칠, 금 귀걸이, 흰 모피 깃, 금 장식 갈색 가죽 하네스, 어깨 금 룬 메달. 무기는 금 나선 룬 돌 망치(양손, 머리는 늘 몸 바깥). 바닥 균열·먼지 효과 없음. size_class large — 칸 112 필요할 수 있음.
